import { createDOMRoot } from "../snapshot/src/native_runtime_api.ts";

__nativeDefineComponent(".cache/structural-locality-recording-v1/diagnostic-v1/frontend-size-v2/native_controller.tsx#component:NativeCollectionMount", NativeCollectionMount, { propOnlySites: [] });

import { beginStructuralCountWindow, endStructuralCountWindow, configureStructuralCountProbe } from "../snapshot/src/structural_count_probe.ts";
import { NativeCollectionBoard, makeRows } from "../../../structural-locality-protocol-v1/eligibility/native_collection.tsx";
import { NativeGenericBoard } from "../../../structural-locality-protocol-v1/eligibility/native_generic.tsx";
function describeThrown(value) {
	const kind = value === null ? "null" : typeof value;
	try {
		return {
			kind,
			message: String(value)
		};
	} catch {
		return {
			kind,
			message: "<unprintable thrown value>"
		};
	}
}
function NativeCollectionMount({ rows, life }) {
	return /* @__PURE__ */ __nativeJsx.jsx(NativeCollectionBoard, {
		rows,
		life
	});
}
export function NativeGenericMount({ initialIds, life, registerIdsSetter }) {
	return /* @__PURE__ */ __nativeJsx.jsx(NativeGenericBoard, {
		initialIds,
		life,
		registerIdsSetter
	});
}
export function mountNativeCount(container, initialIds, life, countMode, profileCounter) {
	configureStructuralCountProbe(countMode);
	const root = createDOMRoot(container, {
		scheduleCommit: () => {},
		profileCounter
	});
	const rows = makeRows(initialIds);
	try {
		root.mount(/* @__PURE__ */ __nativeJsx.jsx(NativeCollectionMount, {
			rows,
			life
		}));
		root.flush();
	} catch (error) {
		try {
			root.dispose();
		} catch (disposal) {
			throw new Error(`mount ${String(error)}; disposal ${String(disposal)}`);
		}
		throw error;
	}
	return {
		click(id) {
			const node = [...container.querySelectorAll("li[data-id]")].find((item) => item.dataset.id === id);
			if (!node) throw new Error(`missing click target ${id}`);
			node.click();
			root.flush();
		},
		reset(operations) {
			if (operations.length === 0) return null;
			const applied = rows.apply(rows.version, operations);
			if (!applied.ok) throw new Error(`reset rejected ${applied.reason}`);
			if (!root.flush()) throw new Error("reset lacked synchronous commit");
			return applied.version;
		},
		edit(label, operations) {
			const statsBefore = rows.stats();
			const expectedVersion = rows.version;
			let applyResult = null;
			let flushResult = null;
			let receipt = null;
			let editThrew = false;
			let editThrown;
			let receiptThrew = false;
			let receiptThrown;
			if (countMode) beginStructuralCountWindow(root, label);
			try {
				applyResult = rows.apply(expectedVersion, operations);
				if (!applyResult.ok) throw new Error(`edit rejected ${applyResult.reason}`);
				flushResult = root.flush();
				if (flushResult !== true) throw new Error("edit lacked synchronous commit");
			} catch (error) {
				editThrew = true;
				editThrown = error;
			} finally {
				if (countMode) try {
					receipt = endStructuralCountWindow(root);
				} catch (error) {
					receiptThrew = true;
					receiptThrown = error;
				}
			}
			const afterCollectionVersion = rows.version;
			const statsAfter = rows.stats();
			const pendingChangeCount = root.diagnostics().pendingChangeCount;
			if (editThrew || receiptThrew) {
				const failure = new Error(`native edit failed: edit=${editThrew ? JSON.stringify(describeThrown(editThrown)) : "none"}; receipt=${receiptThrew ? JSON.stringify(describeThrown(receiptThrown)) : "none"}`);
				Object.assign(failure, {
					editThrew,
					editThrown,
					receiptThrew,
					receiptThrown,
					receipt
				});
				throw failure;
			}
			return {
				receipt,
				statsBefore,
				statsAfter,
				expectedVersion,
				applyResult,
				afterCollectionVersion,
				flushResult,
				pendingChangeCount
			};
		},
		dispose() {
			root.dispose();
			return {
				readerCount: rows.stats().readerCount,
				ownerCount: root.diagnostics().ownerCount
			};
		}
	};
}
